query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_orders, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as delivered_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_at IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_delivery_time
FROM orders
